metas.name: Particle Fever
metas.description: As the Large Hadron Collider is about to be launched for the first time, physicists are on the cusp of the greatest scientific discovery of all time -- or perhaps their greatest failure.

metas.name: The Farthest
metas.description: It is one of humankind's greatest achievements. More than 12 billion miles away a tiny spaceship is leaving our Solar System and entering the void of deep space - the first human-made object ever to do so.

metas.name: Apollo 11
metas.description: A look at the Apollo 11 mission to land on the moon led by commander Neil Armstrong and pilots Buzz Aldrin and Mike Collins.

metas.name: Fire of Love
metas.description: Intrepid scientists and lovers Katia and Maurice Krafft died in a volcanic explosion doing the very thing that brought them together: unraveling the mysteries of volcanoes by capturing the most explosive imagery ever recorded.

metas.name: The Act of Killing
metas.description: A documentary which challenges former Indonesian death-squad leaders to reenact their mass-killings in whichever cinematic genres they wish, including classic Hollywood crime scenarios and lavish musical numbers.

metas.name: Collective
metas.description: Director Alexander Nanau follows a crack team of investigators at the Romanian newspaper Gazeta Sporturilor as they try to uncover a vast health-care fraud that enriched moguls and politicians and led to the deaths of innocent cit...

metas.name: The Look of Silence
metas.description: A family that survived the genocide in Indonesia confronts the men who killed one of their brothers.
metas.country: Denmark, Indonesia, Finland, Norway, United Kingdom, Israel, France, United States, Germany, Netherlands

metas.name: For Sama
metas.description: An intimate and epic journey into a young woman's experience of war during the revolution in Aleppo, Syria.

metas.name: Cameraperson
metas.description: Exposing her role behind the camera, Kirsten Johnson reaches into the vast trove of footage she has shot over decades around the world. What emerges is a visually bold memoir and a revelatory interrogation of the power of the camera.

metas.name: Sans Soleil
metas.description: A woman narrates the contemplative writings of a seasoned world traveler, focusing on contemporary Japan.

metas.name: Stories We Tell
metas.description: A film that excavates layers of myth and memory to find the elusive truth at the core of a family of storytellers.

metas.name: Honeyland
metas.description: The last female bee-hunter in Europe must save the bees and return the natural balance in Honeyland, when a family of nomadic beekeepers invade her land and threaten her livelihood.

metas.name: Nostalgia for the Light
metas.description: A documentary about two different searches conducted in the Chilean Atacama Desert: one by astronomers looking for answers about the history of the cosmos, and one by women looking for the remains of loved ones killed by Pinochet'...

metas.name: All That Breathes
metas.description: Amidst the darkening backdrop of Delhi's apocalyptic air and escalating violence, two brothers devote their lives to protect one casualty of the turbulent times: the bird known as the Black Kite.

metas.name: The Rescue
metas.description: A chronicle of the enthralling, against-all-odds story that transfixed the world in 2018: the daring rescue of twelve boys and their coach from deep inside a flooded cave in Northern Thailand.

metas.name: Writing with Fire
metas.description: In a cluttered news landscape dominated by men, emerges India's only newspaper run by Dalit women. Chief Reporter Meera and her journalists break traditions, redefining what it means to be powerful.

metas.name: Machines
metas.description: A portrait of daily life of the workers in an Indian textile factory, revealing its beauty as well as its shameful working conditions.

metas.name: A Night of Knowing Nothing
metas.description: L, a student in India witness to the government's violent response to university protests, writes letters to her estranged lover while he is away.

metas.name: AlphaGo
metas.description: Google's DeepMind has developed a program for playing the 3000 year old game Go using AI. They test AlphaGo on the European champion, then March 9-15, 2016, on the top player, Lee Sedol, in a best of 5 tournament in Seoul.

metas.name: Human Nature
metas.description: A breakthrough called CRISPR opens the door to curing diseases, reshaping the biosphere, and designing our own children. A provocative exploration of its far-reaching implications, through the eyes of the scientists who discovered...

metas.name: The Bit Player
metas.description: The Bit Player tells the story of an overlooked genius, Claude Shannon (the "Father of Information Theory"), who revolutionized the world, but never lost his childlike curiosity.
